text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel missed out on victory. 
However, after running alongside her, she 
was certain: Narita Brian would become 
even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She is the one... I want to surpass. It 
doesn't have to be right now; the future 
is fine by me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If anything, I want her to become even 
stronger. Strong enough that no one can 
beat her in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Because a chance to defeat Narita Brian 
for the very first time would open up for 
her too. Sakura Laurel begins taking 
straight strides toward the one she 
admires.
